crossRefs.note: Abiathar told David that Saul had slain Yahweh’s priests.

people.name: Abiathar
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Abiathar told David that Saul had slain Yahweh’s priests.
translations.bsb: And Abiathar told David that Saul had killed the priests of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the LORD'S priests.
translations.asv: And Abiathar told David that Saul had slain Jehovah's priests.
